subject: Linguistics
title: Speech Acts
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Speech Acts.

hook.text: When a judge says 'I sentence you to five years,' saying it makes it happen.

buildup.text: Not all sentences just describe the world—some change it through the act of speaking.

discovery.text: J.L. Austin called these performatives: saying 'I promise' creates the promise.

twist.text: Even ordinary statements perform acts—asking 'Is it cold?' can be a request to close a window.

climax.text: Speech act theory shows language is action, not just information transfer.

punchline.text: Words don't just describe—they do things.

quiz.question: Who introduced the concept of performative utterances?
